finding.customer_memo:
Dear Bello Hardware,

We have completed the review of your January 2026 billing dispute.

Your meter register rolled over during January. The register reached its maximum reading of 99,678 on 31 December 2025, then reset to 00111 on 31 January 2026. This is normal behavior for a five-digit meter.

Your actual consumption for January was 433 kWh, consistent with your typical monthly usage of 415 to 441 kWh. However, our billing system did not recognize the rollover and incorrectly calculated 99,433 kWh, resulting in the invoice of NGN 6,801,217.20.

The correct invoice for January 2026 should have been 433 kWh × NGN 68.40 = NGN 29,617.20.

We will reverse invoice CASE-11-INV-07 and reissue the correct amount. A credit adjustment of NGN 6,771,600.00 will be applied to your account, reducing your outstanding balance to NGN 29,617.20.

This adjustment requires approval from our Revenue Assurance Manager and will be processed within 7 working days. You will receive a revised statement once the correction is posted.

We apologize for the error and any inconvenience this has caused your business.

Regards,
Billing Dispute Resolution
